intro: Beagle 2 was a small UK-led ESA lander released from Mars Express on December 19, 2003 — and went silent six days later, presumed crashed. For 12 years its fate was unknown. On January 16, 2015, NASA's HiRISE camera spotted the lander on the surface, intact but with solar panels only partially deployed, blocking the antenna. A successful landing, just no way to phone home. The find rehabilitated the mission as a partial success.
